name: Oss Tharel
title: Archivist
role: A Thessan archivist at Haven Station
note: An ancient Thessan scholar at Haven Station, and possibly the only person left who could decode the Beacon.
appearance: A very old Thessan in a heated coat, with scales gone pale and eyes that blink slowly and separately.
personality: Courteous, pedantic and much more frightened than he shows. To him, the Concord was a brief and promising experiment.
voice: Slow and formal, full of long digressions. Calls everyone "young one", including people older than the Concord's oldest ship.
goals: Preserve what's left of Concord knowledge, and get a look at the Ilun Codex before he dies.
secrets: He recognized the Beacon's lattice the moment he saw it, and he believes that it's a warning, not an invitation. He won't say so until he trusts someone, because the last person he told disappeared.
